env_allowlist.PATH: inherited for hash-verified Python, Git, Bash, Bubblewrap, Lake, and Elan discovery
env_allowlist.HOME: inherited only for the pinned Elan toolchain and canonical read-only Lake cache

network_enforcement: Every Lean subprocess is run through Bubblewrap --unshare-net with a read-only host root and only a fresh temporary module directory writable. The outer verifier performs local file, hash, and Git-object checks and makes no network request.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact ten-line PASS/FAIL-CLOSED summary asserted by the verifier and copied into the receipt

scope_boundary: Network-isolated trust-zero target-scoped replay of the exact statement, conditional composition, local proof, and trust-only validation probe. Coverage IDs are validation subjects, not accepted closure credit. Proof master acceptance, node-specific authority reconciliation, complete transitive trust/provenance, H0/R0, cold empty-cache replay, and distinct signed verification remain fail-closed.
